description:
From Amsterdam to Berlin, two cities of pulse and power finally meet. Frequencies intertwine, energy converges: this is where the current flows one last time before the year fades.
A cross-current of sound, sweat, and motion, where walls breathe and floors shift beneath the weight of rhythm.
Two areas, two energies, one living organism of light and bass.

With artists like SLV, Filtrack, or L’Attitude, the night unfolds layer by layer. Expect moments that stretch beyond the clock, until time bends and the floor dissolves into pure movement.

23h till late.
Come for the closure.
Stay for the release.

Lineup: Conntex, FANK, FILTRACK, Fran LF, L'Attitude (GER), MAURER, nerya, SLV, VOICEX
title: DRIPS X VIBRANT

description:
27.02 — Studio dB, Berlin

For the first time, DRIPS presents a different kind of night.
A night for the community — built on exchange, experimentation, and shared presence.

This is a space where artistic disciplines converge and move together:
fashion in motion, contemporary dance, live music, vinyl, and immersive visuals unfolding throughout the evening. Each element is part of a continuous dialogue between bodies, sound, and image.

An experience designed for creative encounter and collective energy — where performance and audience meet on the same frequency, and the boundaries between scenes begin to dissolve.

description:
[EN]

A new connection between Berlin and Madrid.

DRIPS COLLECTIVE, a Berlin-based multidisciplinary platform exploring techno, visual culture and underground club experiences, joins forces with Madrid’s ORGANIC COMMUNITY for a special collaboration with a 10 hours event at Studio 76.

Our special guest SEPT joins Organic for his Madrid debut, bringing his hypnotic and powerful approach to techno to the dancefloor. With releases on BPitch, BCCO, CLERGY and Flash Recordings, he has established a distinctive presence within the contemporary techno scene.

Two collectives. Two cities. One shared language: techno.

QUEER COMMUNITY SAFE PLACE.
PROTECT THE DANCEFLOOR.

[ES]

Una nueva conexión entre Berlín y Madrid.

DRIPS COLLECTIVE, plataforma multidisciplinar con sede en Berlín que explora el techno, la cultura visual y las experiencias de club underground, se une a ORGANIC COMMUNITY, de Madrid, para una colaboración especial de 10 horas en Studio 76.

Nuestro invitado especial SEPT se une a Organic para su debut en Madrid, llevando a la pista su enfoque hipnótico y contundente del techno. Con lanzamientos en BPitch, BCCO, CLERGY y Flash Recordings, ha consolidado una identidad propia dentro de la escena techno contemporánea.

Dos colectivos. Dos ciudades. Un mismo lenguaje: el techno.

Lineup: Cristal Roto, MAURER, VOICEX, NETN, Sept, Theia Daja, Yonto
title: ORGANIC COMMUNITY x DRIPS (Berlin Showcase)
